name: Kanade
source:
A young WolfHalve who balances his duties as both a resistance chef and medic, Kanade is a gentle soul whose relic weapon is a rarely seen musical instrument.

Has deep feelings for Sekaki, who helped him through a difficult time in his life, though he struggles with being seen as more than the child he once was.

Likes: Playing music, cooking, Sekaki

Dislikes: Seeing others hurt, noisy environments, non-team players

[From the [url=https://arashi.eccentric-studio.org/en/characters/kanade]official description[/url]]
